question: When volcano erupts on Earth, the erupted material is typically a liquid rock known as ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lava.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lava is the correct answer as it is the molten rock that is ejected during a volcanic eruption.
 
• Lava is typically composed of a mixture of molten rock, ash, and gases.
 
• The composition of lava can vary depending on the type of volcano and the type of eruption.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hailstone is a type of precipitation that forms in thunderstorms.**
 
• **Mercury is a liquid metal that is found in the Earth's crust. **
 
• **Plasma **is** state of matter** that is found in stars and other high-energy environments.
